name: com.gameframex.unity.builder
description:
GameFrameX Builder — Unity automated build pipeline package. Drives Unity builds via -executeMethod for Android, iOS, WebGL, and standalone targets with command-line configuration of build number, channel, language, and package version. Supports asset bundle pipelines (Builtin/Scriptable/RawFile), optional HybridCLR integration, optional upload to QiNiu/Tencent/ALiYun object storage, and enterprise WeChat bot notification after builds. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Builder — Unity 自动化打包构建功能包。通过 -executeMethod 驱动 Android、iOS、WebGL 和桌面平台的构建，可由命令行参数配置构建号、渠道、语言与包版本。支持资源包构建管线（Builtin/Scriptable/RawFile）、可选 HybridCLR 集成、可选上传至七牛/腾讯/阿里云对象存储，以及构建完成后的企业微信机器人通知。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
